studio-blue-green.title: Old Drake · Charleston area, South Carolina
studio-blue-green.evidence: The builder explicitly identifies Studio Blue Green SW 0047 on the siding and stucco in its answer attached to the first photograph. Both exterior views from the seven-photo project are included; the other five entries are interiors. This is a direct professional attribution. The photographs look quite gray and show pale trim, while the written answer names Hunt Club trim, so that visual discrepancy is preserved here rather than explained away.
